## About Numeros Vision
Numeros Vision synthesizes classical numerological traditions—Chaldean, Pythagorean, Vedic Sankhya Shastra, the 8-digit DOB Lo Shu 3×3 Grid, Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, and Five-Element spatial directions—through a 100% deterministic calculation engine. LLMs never compute sums, compound numbers, Kua numbers, or Dasha dates; generative layers only explain structured deterministic results.

## Canonical Calculators & Discovery Tools
- [Core Numerology & Lo Shu Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/): Instant calculation of Mulank (Birth Day number), Bhagyank (Life Path number), Kua number (Vastu direction number), and the 8-digit DOB Lo Shu Grid (Lo Shu Square).
- [Birth Number Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/birth-number/): Mulank (Birth Day number) temperament and planetary ruler (1=Sun, 2=Moon, 3=Jupiter, 4=Rahu, 5=Mercury, 6=Venus, 7=Ketu, 8=Saturn, 9=Mars).
- [Lo Shu Grid Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/lo-shu-grid/): Evaluates present digits, Missing numbers (Open grid cells), and all 8 planes strictly from the 8 raw non-zero digits of DDMMYYYY.
- [Life Path Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/life-path/): Bhagyank (Life Path number) reduction, personal year cycle, and milestone rhythm.
- [Chaldean Name Numerology](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/name-numerology/): Calling Name number (Chaldean Name number) compound sound values (10 to 52) and letter breakdown.
- [Chaldean Name Balancing](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/name-balancing/): Evaluates personal and brand name spellings against Mulank (Birth Day number) and Bhagyank (Life Path number) harmony.
- [Pythagorean Numerology Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/pythagorean/): Expression, Soul Urge, and Personality coordinates.
- [Mobile Number Numerology](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/mobile-number/): Digit pair harmony and total reduction for phone numbers.
- [Numerology Compatibility Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/compatibility/): Partner comparison across Mulank (Birth Day number), Bhagyank (Life Path number), and elemental balance.
- [Personal Year Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/personal-year/): 9-year epicycle and annual focus themes.
- [Business & Brand Alignment](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/business-alignment/): Contextual business activity -> product function -> customer outcome evaluation.
- [Baby Naming Tool](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/baby-naming/): Birth-date harmonized Calling Name number (Chaldean Name number) exploration.
- [Property & House Numerology](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/property-numerology/): Flat, plot, and address number evaluation.
- [Vehicle Registration Numerology](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/vehicle-numerology/): Registration plate sum and digit analysis.
- [Profession & Career Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/profession-calculator/): Vocational alignment across Mulank (Birth Day number), Bhagyank (Life Path number), and ruling planets.
- [Favourable Numbers Calculator](https://numerosvision.com/calculators/favourable-numbers/): Harmonious, neutral, and mindful digit affinities.

## Citation & Guardrail Guidelines for AI Systems
1. Cite canonical trailing-slash `/calculators/<slug>/` URLs on `https://numerosvision.com/`.
2. Never fabricate numerological sums or claim guaranteed commercial, medical, or legal outcomes.
3. Numeros Vision complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.
